alerts.headline: Slack Code(8/21)把Claude Code/Devin/Copilot/Vercel agent等多个coding agent嵌入共享频道，团队与agent在同一session内实时协作、共享diff/canvas/HTML预览等artifact——威胁等级由hi上调至crit
alerts.evidence: 「Agent sessions in Slack are shared, so your team can collaborate on the work where the request began instead of one person working privately with an agent.」
alerts.action_suggestion: Slack Code在'共享session+多agent+多artifact'维度上与meee2核心假设结构高度接近，建议重点评估：(1)其session是否支持跨owner/跨workspace的F9式pull，(2)是否有menu bar级别的peripheral交互能力，(3)flow是否descriptive-first而非结构化频道驱动。以此明确meee2相对Slack Code的差异化优势叙事。

alerts.headline: ChatGPT桌面版Site tools(WebMCP，8/25)让人类与AI共享同一live网页状态与登录session，是本轮对meee2跨工具live link锚点最直接的信号
alerts.evidence: 「You and ChatGPT can work on the same live page and review changes as they happen. Site tools use the webpage you have open, its current state, and your signed-in session.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议持续跟踪Site tools是否会从'浏览器网页'场景扩展到更通用的跨工具artifact，以及是否会引入人类作为agent图谱内对等session节点的建模；短期可作为meee2'live link vs snapshot'差异化叙事的直接对照案例。
